name: CSL Finance Ltd
title: CSL Finance Ltd - 530067 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: CSL Finance's wholesale book grows but SME retail stalled: AUM up 21% to Rs 1,448 cr, yet SME share fell to 31% and Q4 disbursements dropped 16% QoQ to Rs 301 cr.

triggers.label: SME retail stalled, share 48% to 31%
triggers.quote: SME retail performance has been underwhelming

triggers.label: New lenders entering sub-Rs 10 lakh SME
triggers.quote: influx of new competition from previously MSI heavy lenders who are now lending aggressively in their secured SME portfolio

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 15%-25%
triggers.quote: The next year guidance will be in line with anything between 15%-25%

triggers.label: Gross NPA 1.1% vs 0.46% a year ago
triggers.quote: Gross NPA stood at 1.1% in Q4FY26 compared to 0.46% in Q4FY25

triggers.label: Q4 PAT down 7% QoQ on ECL and write-offs
triggers.quote: PAT for Quarter 4 FY26 was reported as Rs. 19.4 crore which was up by 2% year-on-year though down 7% sequentially

guidance.quote: The next year guidance will be in line with anything between 15%-25%
the credit cost which has been around 0.5%, I think we should be stabilizing between that credit cost only
we don't expect that the absolute gross and net NPA should increase in the next financial year

red_flags.label: SME growth stalled; branch attrition and team changes
red_flags.quote: there have been changes in the senior team that resulted in some attrition, I would say little higher attrition in our branches

red_flags.label: Gross NPA up to 1.1% from 0.46%
red_flags.quote: Gross NPA stood at 1.1% in Q4FY26 compared to 0.46% in Q4FY25

red_flags.label: Lower ECL/NPA resolutions, higher H2 impairments
red_flags.quote: We recorded higher impairments in the second half of the year partly due to lower NPA resolutions

red_flags.label: Management to reset SME policies, no SME guidance
red_flags.quote: we would be better to comment on any projections and the numbers and the expansion strategy in the coming quarters itself

evasions.quote: we would be better to comment on any projections and the numbers and the expansion strategy in the coming quarters itself
it is better to see it more on a yearly basis rather than quarterly
